strategies.name: The Big Short — broader weak-stock rally short

validation.procedure: market-level calendar-aligned walk-forward; deployment filters applied in IS and OOS
validation.rs: point-in-time cross-sectional 63-session rank, applied in IS and OOS
validation.regime: signal-bar index close vs SMA200, applied in IS and OOS
validation.executionReference: proposal levels anchored to latest completed close; OOS fills use next-session open
caveats: Historical validation uses the current/curated universe; survivorship bias is not fully eliminated.
Drawdown uses realized exits rather than mark-to-market equity and can understate intratrade drawdown.
Daily OHLC cannot reveal intraday ordering beyond the conservative stop-first rule when both stop and target are touched.

ranking.method: heuristic evidence-tier + trend + expectancy + R:R + RS + freshness
ranking.note: Ranking orders proposals; it is not itself a separately validated alpha model.
